title: Multiple issues with Flatpak build: icon, cursor size, and DBus failure
body:
While testing the app in Flatpak, the following 3 issues occurred:

1. **The app did not get the correct icon.**
2. **The mouse cursor in the app is extremely small.**
3. **Failed to register the MPRIS media session** on startup:
   ```
   [16:08:44 INF] Starting application...
   [16:08:44 ERR] Failed to register the MPRIS media session
   Tmds.DBus.Protocol.DBusErrorReplyException: org.freedesktop.DBus.Error.ServiceUnknown: org.freedesktop.DBus.Error.ServiceUnknown
      at Tmds.DBus.Protocol.InnerConnection.MyValueTaskSource`1.System.Threading.Tasks.Sources.IValueTaskSource<T>.GetResult(Int16 token)
      at Tmds.DBus.Protocol.InnerConnection.CallMethodAsync[T](MessageBuffer message, MessageValueReader`1 valueReader, Object state)
      at Tmds.DBus.Protocol.InnerConnection.RequestNameAsync(String serviceName, RequestNameOptions flags, Action`2 onAcquired, Action`2 onLost, Object actionState, Boolean emitOnCapturedContext)
      at Tmds.DBus.Protocol.DBusConnection.TryRequestNameAsync(String name, RequestNameOptions options, Action`2 onLost, Object actionState, Boolean emitOnCapturedContext)
      at Tmds.DBus.Protocol.DBusConnection.RequestNameAsync(String name, RequestNameOptions options, Action`2 onLost, Object actionState, Boolean emitOnCapturedContext)
      at Ohrbob.App.Desktop.MprisMediaSession.InitializeAsync() in /run/build/ohrbob/Ohrbob.App.Desktop/MprisMediaSession.cs:line 64
   ```
